caption: The video captures a rocky landscape under a partly cloudy sky, with a pale pile of broken rocks and dirt ground fixed in the foreground before a long dark mound of rubble. From the crest of that mound an eruption is already underway, throwing up a compact column of dark debris capped with white smoke. The column grows taller and broader, loosening into a wide fan-shaped spray of dark particles scattered high against the sky. White smoke churns at the plume's base and rolls rightward, hugging the ground. The airborne cloud of dark ejecta keeps expanding upward and outward toward the top of the frame, while the foreground pile and ridge stay fixed, confirming a static viewpoint. The blast is still dispersing at the final frame, not yet settling.
